2511-6277-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-7741-8320.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Yoshimaru and Shang-Chi.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

643-2638-3510-8168.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-2638-3510-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

1981-2415-3899-7192.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

1008-4644-7791.description:
Activate Undermountain Adventurer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Undermountain Adventurer.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Undermountain Adventurer.
Repeat.

1267-4064-7712.manaNeeded: {1}{U} the first turn plus {1}{W}{U} each extra turn
1267-4064-7712.description:
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast The Wondrous Wasp by paying {1}{U}.
When The Wondrous Wasp enters, it triggers, tapping Medomai and causing it to lose all its abilities until The Wondrous Wasp leaves the battlefield.
Move to your next turn.
Declare Medomai as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Abuelo by paying {1}{W}{U}, exiling The Wondrous Wasp until your end step. This will also cause Medomai to regain its abilities.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Abuelo triggers, returning The Wondrous Wasp from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1183-4853-7434.description:
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Brass Infiniscope.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1183-4853-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

1806-2060-5231-6627-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to The Earth Crystal.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

240-4927-5231-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1329-5315-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1329-5315-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

628-3723-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

2191-4924-7070.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that has base toughness 2 or greater
2191-4924-7070.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Monk Gyatso.
Activate Monk Gyatso by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
Monk Gyatso's ability from step 4 fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Heartless Summoning.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-3490-5231-6823.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-5231-6823.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

4872-6333-6334.manaNeeded: {U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
4872-6333-6334.description:
Cast Time Warp from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Vanishing by paying {U}{U}, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

1251-3204-4251-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1251-3204-4251-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-586-3771-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
413-586-3771-5258-5618.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

204-392-1753-1858-2056.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

373-877-4050-4484.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
373-877-4050-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

4702-5153.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
4702-5153.description:
Activate Sunstrike Legionnaire by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the token Sunstrike Legionnaire enters the battlefield, each Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.

2034-2661-4484.notablePrerequisites:
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich had died this turn.
2034-2661-4484.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {B}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Repeat.

703-2517.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, creating two token copies of Parallax Wave that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Active the first Parallax Wave token's first ability by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Astral Dragon.
Activate the same Parallax Wave token's ability up to four more times, targeting any creatures.
Resolve any of those abilities that target creatures you own, exiling them.
In response to the remaining abilities, activate the second Parallax Wave token's ability by removing a fade counter from it, exiling the first Parallax Wave token.The first Parallax Wave token leaves the battlefield, returning Astral Dragon and any other creatures you exiled from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the remaining activated abilities from Parallax Wave that target creatures your opponents control, permanently exiling them.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite Parallax Wave tokens, you may repeat the combo but target any other noncreature permanent in step 2, getting infinite creature copies of them.

2034-2660-2757-4545.notablePrerequisites:
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
You control a basic Forest.
2034-2660-2757-4545.description:
Cast Skyshroud Sentinel by paying {2}{G}.
When Skyshroud Sentinel enters the battlefield, it triggers.
In response to this trigger, activate Earthcraft by tapping Skyshroud Sentinel, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Skyshroud Sentinel and putting it on the bottom of your library, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Skyshroud Sentinel's trigger, searching your library for a card named Skyshroud Sentinel and putting it into your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

413-1003-1069-5222.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker.
Untap Blasting Station.
Equip Sword of the Realms to Phyrexian Walker for {0}.
Activate Blasting Station, sacrificing Phyrexian Walker deal 1 damage to any target.
Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker to your hand.
Repeat.

225-433-539-573.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Llanowar Scout as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
